fields.label: Sheet Size
fields.description: The press sheet this combination was confirmed on.

fields.label: Finished Height (cm)
fields.description: Matches either way round - a piece confirmed as 21x29.7 also matches a job entered as 29.7x21, same physical size.

fields.label: Confirmed Ups per Sheet
fields.description: The REAL ups Mofeed (or whoever) actually confirmed for this exact sheet + finished-size combination - not a calculated or estimated figure.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Who confirmed this and when, plus any useful context - e.g. 'Mofeed, 2026-08-19, matches the published 8-up A4 imposition standard (SRA1 reference)'. This is what makes the entry trustworthy to reuse - an unsourced number here is worse than no entry at all.
